channel.description: Latest articles from The Garden Island (thegardenisland.com)

item.title: Celebrating ‘Olelo Hawaii: The Native Hawaiian Language is thriving on Kauai and Niihau
item.description: February is recognized as Mahina ‘Olelo Hawaii, or “Hawaiian Language Month,” and Kauai joined the statewide celebrations and festivities.

item.title: Kauai sees more whales during recent count
item.description: LIHUE — For the second time this year, 487 volunteers collected data on kohola, or humpback whales, from the shores of Kauai, Oahu, Molokai and Hawaii Island during the Hawaiian Humpback Whale National Marine Sanctuary Ocean Count on Saturday.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Close rental car firms’ tax loophole
item.description: Four bills on the Legislature’s agenda aim to impose Hawaii’s 4.5% general excise tax (GET) on rental car companies’ vehicle purchases — a tax change that’s a good idea and should be implemented.

item.title: New Hawaii rental car tax proposed
item.description: Hawaii lawmakers are eyeing the local rental car industry as a resource to rev up tax revenue amid state budget concerns.

item.title: OperAloha opens at St. Michael’s
item.description: LIHUE — A unique evening of fine opera and hula awaits guests to OperAloha, presented by Chamber Music Kauai on March 7 at the St. Michael’s and All Angels Church in Lihue.

item.title: High-spending visitors help drive economic gains
item.description: Hawaii’s economy looks a bit brighter as high-income tourists from the mainland continue to spend more, driven especially by a boost in visitor spending on Maui.

item.title: Pickleball tournament boosts Charity Walk fundraising
item.description: LIHUE — The three-day pickleball tournament that wrapped up on Sunday provided a big boost to the 2026 Visitor Industry Charity Walk, which has a goal of raising $700,000.

item.title: Driving with aloha in Waimea
item.description: Mayor Derek S.K. Kawakami declared Monday as Drive with Aloha Day for the blessing and dedication of the student-driven mural on traffic safety mural that graces the makai wall of the Richard Doi athletic building at Waimea High School, facing the Clem Gomes Gym.

item.title: Life’s Choices awards $1 million
item.description: LIHUE — Prosecuting Attorney Rebecca Like recently announced the recipients of $1,000,000 in grant funding. Thirteen non-profit community organizations will be receiving grants through the Life’s Choices Adult and Adolescent Mental Health and Substance Abuse Grant Program.
